intro.caption: FORM 1-A · NOTICE OF DECEASE — You have died. Do not be alarmed; it is quite common.
Your file has been forwarded to Intake. Please proceed to the counter and wait to be called.
FORM 2-C · OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT — Position: Intake Clerk (Temporary); duties: stamp; benefits: none.
Your predecessor is currently being processed. The desk is yours.

training.title: Stamp the soul.
training.text: Then stamp the next one. Souls are the currency here; fifteen Karma Credits hires your first clerk.

training.title: Hire Dave.
training.text: Karma Credits pay the staff who stamp for you while you are away.

training.title: That is the job.
training.text: Souls pay Karma Credits; Karma hires staff; the Backlog Report pays you when you come back.

tips.title: Watch the bar.
tips.text: Each fill pays out: the clerk files a batch and you are credited souls and Karma. More staff and milestones make it faster.

tips.title: Milestones, not raises.
tips.text: Every milestone doubles this clerk's speed. The next one is at {next}. Hiring toward it is nearly always the best use of Karma.

tips.title: Bulk filing is still filing.
tips.text: You can afford more than one hire. ×10 hires ten at once; ×max hires as many as your Karma covers. Handy when a milestone is a few desks away.

tips.title: An upgrade is affordable.
tips.text: Upgrades are one-off purchases that speed up a whole department or your stamp. Buy them when you can; they outlast any single hire.

tips.title: The office never closes.
tips.text: Staff keep working while the app is closed, up to your offline cap. Come back, collect the Backlog Report, spend it on staff, leave again. That is the whole career.

tips.title: A new department has opened.
tips.text: Tap its chip to move desks. Every department you own keeps earning at once, wherever you sit; each has its own staff and upgrades.

tips.title: Requisitions.
tips.text: Vouchers buy personnel cards: one for {pull}, ten for {ten} (a discount, for once).{free} Senior staff are guaranteed within {pity} pulls. The odds are posted at the bottom, as regulations require.

tips.title: Put them to work.
tips.text: Equipped cards boost output. Duplicates add stars. Tap a card in your Collection to equip it; a card in the drawer helps nobody.

tips.title: A duplicate, in triplicate.
tips.text: Copies of a card you already own bank toward its next star, and each star makes the card stronger. {card} needs {need} more for its next star. Rarer cards need fewer copies.

tips.title: Daily tasks.
tips.text: Daily tasks pay vouchers. Claim them before midnight, when the list is reshuffled. A skip token writes off one you cannot finish; a finished week pays a bonus.

tips.title: The Annual Audit.
tips.text: An Audit closes the fiscal year: staff, upgrades and departments reset, and you are paid permanent Seals. Each Seal adds 2% to all output forever and buys perks here. File one when progress slows; the next year goes faster.
